task: must-trade option timing, payoff-first broad search
validation: custody-eval-2026-09-14 is excluded from ALL loading, ranking and diagnostics; no new held-out claims
signal_input: only exact underlying current-session completed 1m OHLCV; static DTE permitted for timing clock; option prices execution/PnL only
primary_fill: next positive-volume option close at least one minute after intent; original v1 execution semantics, no backfill
search_stages: entry family grid with fixed exits
12000 deterministic broad combinations from declared domains
up to 2000 prespecified local perturbations of 12 diverse leaders
shortlist up to 160 including payoff and expectancy leaders; joint cost/delay pressure
select with declared robust payoff criterion; full-service parity and component ablations

selection.base_eligibility: 124 complete; positive USD and equal-case premium mean after 0.65 per side plus 25 bps per side; positive winning and losing sample counts
selection.nominal_champion: largest min(dollar_payoff, premium_return_payoff) at primary cost
selection.robust_preferred: full coverage and positive dollar/return mean in all five execution scenarios (delay1/2/3 at25bps; delay1 at50/100bps), and positive mean premium returns in each descriptive chronological block (first6/middle6/last7 dates); maximize minimum dual payoff across scenarios
selection.fallback_if_none: report absence; among base eligible choose most passing conditions, then worst-scenario dual payoff; do not claim all tests passed
selection.ties: higher primary equal-case net mean then canonical config id

anti_overfit: all train dates previously observed; chronological/leave-symbol/neighbor evidence internal only; publish all attempts; no stock/direction/day-specific parameters; no winner deletion; no no_entry; no fixed profit target
execution_safety: dryrun only; never connect OpenD or dispatch broker; frozen original v1 preserved in its worktree
